canonical_name: CUI on Portable Storage Not Encrypted
description: Controlled Unclassified Information stored on portable storage devices is not encrypted. This signal indicates that CUI may be exposed if portable storage devices are lost, stolen, or improperly accessed.
applicability: Applicable to all portable storage devices containing CUI. Includes USB drives, external hard drives, SD cards, and other removable media used to store or transport CUI.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through portable storage encryption policy review, device encryption status verification, and DLP monitoring for unencrypted CUI transfers.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
